デバッグモード\nフィールド切り替え
Huh! What a stubborn and bad big tree!!\nJust get covered in crystals already...!\nHm?!
What? I'm just a nosy guy who can't turn a blind\neye when someone is in trouble.
A no-account creature like you who gives a hard\ntime to the beautiful flowering sakura tree should\nbe punished hard, and we're here to do that!!
Uh...um...\nDarn it! You guys stole my lines, now I'm running\noutta cool things to say!!
Ridiculous!! This tree will be covered in crystals\nsoon! Then it'll cover this world with crystals!!\nI won't forgive those getting in my way!!
Who needs your forgiveness!\nLet's see how you're gonna do that!!
I-I...I can see it...T-this world...\nIt's getting covered in beautiful crystals...\nI-I win...
Wow...\nThat's a lot of sakura blooming....
Oh...this is awesome indeed.\nI guess this is what we call breathtakingly\nbeautiful...
Totally agree! It took us so much effort but if we\ncan see something beautiful like this, it's\nworth it! Well, let's rock and roll!
Yes, because the crystals that were gnawing at the\ntree are gone. Thank you so much.
Our sakura garden may be exposed to danger again\nin the future...
We may need to trouble you again when that\nhappens, so please kindly help us again!
Don't you worry!! In exchange for that, let us\nchill under your trees sometimes!\nAlright, let's get ready for a feast!!
Darn it! You didn't learn your lesson...
Oh, don't move! Unlike last time, today I'm taking\nthis tree hostage. If you don't wanna see it get\ngnawed at further, get out of here!!
Oh yeah? You bastard! You really think that we're\ngonna get out of here?!
I'm afraid we're not some impersonal, heartless\nbeings that overlook someone being treated\nunreasonably!
Thank you everyone. The day sakura world can\nremain peaceful because you saved my tree...
Don't mention it! I'm glad everyone is okay.\nWell, we've spent quite some time here.\nPerhaps Libera's back too, so we should go back.
There seems to be other monsters that are\ntargeting this world. We'll try to come and make\na patrol more frequently...
Please patrol this place too when you're free.\nTry to call for help if you see a powerful enemy.\nAight, I'll see you around then. Take care!
I'd like to thank you too, adventurer. Thanks to\nyou, everything in the day sakura world is fine.
It's nothing special, but please take this...
W-whoa, is it really okay for us to accept this\nkind of reward?! F-f-f-fine then, we'll take it,\nthanks!
Please come back soon.\nLet's throw a fun feast together next time!
We'll be waiting for you here with Celesa.
